current.text: He is a rookie. Philadelphia drafted him 22nd overall.
He starts the season as a backup behind Tyrese Maxey and VJ Edgecombe.
Philadelphia also added the guards Anfernee Simons and Kentavious Caldwell-Pope, so the guard rotation is crowded.
In Summer League he played with restraint on 28% usage. He averaged 6 assists and 1.5 steals but shot 26% from three and 63% from the line.
The experts see no real role for him in Philadelphia this season. His path to minutes behind the Sixers' guards is called almost impossible.
Nick Nurse plays his starters and guards very heavy minutes, which limits rookie value on this team.
The experts rated him a top 10 prospect before the draft and think he may be better than Jared McCain. One dynasty rookie ranking puts him 14th.
He could grow into a 27-minute player in about two years, or get traded into a starting role.
His projection gives no fantasy value in a 12-team league. He is not a draft pick for our auction.

durable.text: One expert expects him to become a good shooter over time, despite poor Summer League shooting.

His projection (6.9 points, 2.0 assists, no category outlier) has no 9-cat value while he backs up Maxey and Edgecombe for a coach who gives his starters heavy minutes. Early in the season, only check whether a trade or a long guard injury gives him real minutes. Even then, the experts say Philadelphia's bench offers no easy fantasy replacements.
